desc: Derive and verify the visibility threshold: show building i is visible iff h > max_{k<i} (H_k X_i - H_i X_k)/(X_i-X_k).
Prove the adjacent-pair reduction via the transform (u,v)=(1/X,H/X), where a non-adjacent slope is a weighted average of consecutive slopes.
Implement O(N) exact fraction maximum and required output formatting (-1, 0.000000000000000000, positive .18f); all four samples pass.
Check edge cases and precision: N=1, negative/zero/positive maximum, strict touching blocked, large values.
